ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Ascended[/h1]
A radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers, built around a two-hand visor interface: procedural Unity UGUI radials for tools/bags/equipment, SmartStow+, a document-driven visor HUD with per-profile themes, and the Universal Inventory. Client-side optional mod. [h3]Two curated HUD themes ship in the box — Stationeers Blue and Pure HUD — fully editable in-game with the F9 HUD Designer[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Ascended WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Ascended — Radials for tools/bags/equipment, SmartStow+, the Universal Inventory, and a two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping the game's own physical inventory rules.

The visor HUD is a document-driven layout you can reshape live in the F9 HUD Designer: move/resize/restyle any element, fork a look per suit tier, and save it as your own profile. Radials, the Universal Inventory and the Control Center menu all retint together with whichever profile theme is active. Two curated themes ship by default: Stationeers Blue and Pure HUD.
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.9.2.5 EXPERIMENTAL — YOUR HUD, YOUR RULES: PER-SUIT STYLES + TOTAL THEMES:[/h3] [list] [*] STYLE EVERY ELEMENT PER SUIT MODE: any HUD element can now fork its ENTIRE look between bare and suited (colours, glass, effects, icon tint — all of it, not just two colours). Turn the fork on for an element in the F9 designer and edit each mode independently; everything remembers and round-trips. The old system silently leaked most settings between modes — fixed at the root [*] THEMES NOW CARRY EVERYTHING: a saved profile's theme includes the radial menus (size, colours, effects, hint bar), the Universal Inventory skin AND the F10 Control Center skin — switch profiles and the whole mod retints as one. Performance settings deliberately stay global (a theme carries a look, not a framerate). Your current look is stamped into your existing profiles on first launch, so nothing changes until you want it to [*] REAL PROFILE MANAGEMENT: New (blank slate), Duplicate, Rename, Delete (with confirm, never the active one) and "Restore shipped version" — in F9 and the F10 Profiles tab. Break a shipped theme? Restore it in one click, or delete it and a pristine copy returns next launch [*] THE F9 DESIGNER, REORGANIZED: the Effects wall of dropdowns is now clean sub-tabs (Glass / Edges / Glow / Bloom / Alerts / Transitions / Advanced), the Theme tab leads with the palette wheels, jargon got plain names, the active tab and the suit mode you are editing are clearly marked, and long profile names no longer get cut off [*] TINT ITEM ICONS is now per-element too: keep the global switch, or give any element its own tint colour (or none) — separately per suit mode [*] SPRING CLEANING: the pre-0.9 legacy HUD, the old fixed-panel HUD and the old ImGui radial renderer are gone — the document-driven HUD IS the mod now. Your config is migrated automatically (dead settings cleaned out, old glitch settings carried over) [*] SAFETY NET: a corrupt profile is quarantined to a .broken backup instead of being overwritten; "uiareset" console command + an F10 "Restore shipped themes" button give you a clean-slate path without hunting folders [*] Plus: the F10 menu now fully matches Pure HUD (and every theme) including its border and dividers; the radial accent colour is themeable (and still orange by default) [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.2.0 EXPERIMENTAL — THEMES THAT TRAVEL + THE RADIAL/CURSOR POLISH:[/h3] [list] [*] THE CURSOR NO LONGER FLICKERS IN RADIALS: the arrow pointer strobing while a radial was open is fixed at the root — the "walk/jump/jetpack while a wheel is up" feature was hiding and re-showing the cursor every physics frame. It now only touches the cursor on the exact frames you actually press jump or jetpack [*] MIDDLE-MOUSE ONLY CLOSES A RADIAL: tapping MMB over an item while a radial is open used to select that item — now it just closes the wheel (and dumps any chips you were sorting to the ground, as before) [*] PER-PROFILE THEMES: your HUD colours, glass/glow effects and the radial palette now travel WITH the saved profile — switch profiles and the whole look changes together. Shipped with two curated themes, [b]Stationeers Blue[/b] and [b]Pure HUD[/b] (the old themes are kept in an "Old Themes" folder you can still load) [*] PROJECTED-LENS THEMING: moodlet warning words, per-element colours, icon toggles, optional scan-lines and a carried-item tint — the HUD reads like one coherent projected display [*] DRAG FROM HANDS / 1-6 INTO ANY WINDOW: dragging an item out of a hand box or a 1-6 equipment box into the Universal Inventory or a pinned bag now lands every time (a fast flick-drop used to miss and drop at your feet) [*] VANILLA PLACEMENT BOX WHEN DRAGGING FROM A RADIAL: dragging a chip/item from a radial toward a locker, charger or device slot now shows the game's own coloured placement box (green place/swap, yellow merge, blue insert, red refused) [*] GREYED RADIAL ITEMS ARE STILL DRAGGABLE: with both hands full, a greyed item won't jump into your hand on click — but you can still drag it out as an icon onto the world, a bag or a slot [*] SMART STOW (G) WORKS WITH A RADIAL OPEN: hold the belt wheel, press G, and a belt tool stows to the belt (with the "went in here" flash) — the wedge updates in place [*] EQUIPMENT DAMAGE BARS: a worn item taking damage shows a thin health bar under its icon (green -> yellow -> red), exactly like the vanilla inventory, tinted by the game's OWN damage gradient; the body damage-doll matches it [*] Fixes: splitting a stack to the ground no longer spawns the items inside you (they're placed and launched clear, no self-damage); a suit-power moodlet could get stuck lit in the borrowed status strip — fixed [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.1.1 EXPERIMENTAL — STABILITY, DRAG POLISH + SIZE KNOBS:[/h3] [list] [*] DRAG ANYTHING, ANYWHERE: drag items freely between the Universal Inventory, pinned bags, your hands, the 1-6 equipment slots and the world — both directions. The carried item now always draws IN FRONT of the windows, and pinned bags finally accept drops (they no longer freeze the item at their edge) [*] MENUS ON TOP: opening the pause menu (Esc), the IC10 logic editor, or Stationpedia now hides the inventory windows so the game's menu is on top — and they come back exactly as they were when you close it [*] SMART STOW respects consumable containers: it will no longer stuff items into a water-bottle bag, a cereal-bar box, a burger/egg box or the game-start supplies package — those are no longer treated as storage (real bags, belts and crates still work; ore still fills mining bags) [*] CURSOR is stable in radials: fixed a flicker of the world-selection highlight when you opened a radial and swept to a wedge with the inventory open, plus a one-frame hitch on open. The "hold to look around in a radial" feature was removed (it was unreliable) — the cursor is simply free while any radial is open [*] MORE F9 SIZE KNOBS (F9 > the inventory > Sizes): the manila tab icon, the Sort button, the window close/X button, and the pinned-window title icon + title text — all adjust live, alongside the existing cell/column/tab-size knobs [*] Fixed pinned bag windows rendering as solid yellow boxes (they're frosted glass again) [*] Stability: fixed a hot-reload issue that could make the cursor lag over a long dev session; a stray per-frame error can no longer flood the log or tank the frame rate [/list] [i]Full version history (0.9.1.0 and earlier) is in CHANGELOG.md, in the mod folder and on GitHub.[/i]
